title: The Lost Child
description: You have taken care of the Withering Zones marked by Rana as well as the Spinocrocodiles. The children at Vimara Village should be safe now. Head back with Rana.

mainQuestExcel.title: The Lost Child
mainQuestExcel.description: You have taken care of the Withering Zones marked by Rana as well as the Spinocrocodiles. The children at Vimara Village should be safe now. Head back with Rana.

dialogs.text: I'm so glad you both could come with me. Still, I'll need to report the expansion of the nearby Withering Zone to Tighnari.
Eh? Is that... the kid from Vimara Village?
Eh? Iotham! Wait up!

flow.stepDescription: Go into the depths of the cave to look for Iotham

dialogs.text: ...Who are you people? Don't get in our way.
Hmph, I should be asking you that question! I'm a Forest Watcher here, and I'm in the middle of searching for a missing child. State your names!
It's the Fatui! Where did they come from?
Huh? So, these are the Fatui that Alphonso mentioned? State your business.
Alphonso...? Whatever, don't think you'll be getting out of here without a fight!
Well, looks like we're not gonna be able to talk this one out!
It's the Fatui. Be careful.
#Thank goodness you were here, {NICKNAME}...
Don't worry.
Looks like Alphonso wasn't kidding, these Fatui guys are dangerous...
Anyway, we can talk more about that later. Iotham must be somewhere deeper in the cave. We'd better keep moving.
You fought well.
Really? Hehe, probably because you and Paimon were by my side.

flow.stepDescription: Proceed deeper within to look for Iotham

dialogs.text: Iotham... What happened...
#Wah, Rana... and {NICKNAME}...
Eh? What're you doing in... a Withering Zone... And there are so many monsters...
I'll take care of this.
No... There's no time...
#Darn it! {NICKNAME}, let's do this together!
Iotham, wait here and don't move! We're coming to rescue you!
What's that green thing...?

flow.stepDescription: Try to clean up the Withering Zone

dialogs.text: Whew... Hah... Finally...
Rana... Waaah...

Iotham... It's okay, little man, there's nothing to cry about. Look... If I can tell them about what I felt in the Withering Zone... to those Akademiya researchers... they'll be able to take care of The Withering for good...
#And... did you see... me fight? No... did you see {NICKNAME} fight? Be sure to thank {M#him}{F#her}...
Rana...
Please, that's enough.
Rana, you'd better rest now...
Ha... haha... it's fine. I just feel a little dizzy, that's all. And a little tired...
Rana... I'm sorry...
Wh... What are you talking about? You're my little tiger, so no more crying! You're okay, aren't you? Does anything hurt, Iotham...? Do you feel dizzy, weak, or...
I'm fine, but Rana, you...
It's nothing... I'll be fine. I'm a battle-hardened Forest Watcher, after all! Let's go!
I'll go get help.
#I'm sorry... {NICKNAME}, Paimon, I need to rest... Wait for me, Iotham.
Rana, are you really okay...?
We'll go get help...
No, no, it's fine... I just need... a little rest...
I'm sorry, Rana... I'm sorry...
Really... How many times do I have to say it? I'm fine! But I'm very angry...
You promised me... that you wouldn't go into the forest. Once I'm all rested up, I'll teach you a lesson about breaking promises... you little rascal...
Waaah... Alphonso said that the mushrooms here are huge! And I just wanted to bring you some fresh mushrooms to eat... to give you energy...
Dummy... You didn't need to do that. Just thinking of you guys gives me energy...
Still, hahaha... the mushrooms here really are huge... They'd definitely taste great in a curry...
Did Alphonso let you come here?
No... Alphonso also told me not to go running off. But I wanted to give Rana something tasty to eat, so I...
Alphonso wouldn't do that, he's Iotham's big brother...
Paimon understands... But Iotham, how did you get stuck in the Withering Zone?
When I was in the forest, I thought someone was following me... I got scared, I thought it was Marana's Avatar... So, I just kept running... *sob*
And I ended up running into Marana...
"Marana"?
That's... The Withering.
Oh... Yeah, The Withering.
"Marana's Avatar"?
Uh-huh. It does bad things in the world for Marana... It's a big black thing...
Marana... What a strange name.
Mm... How did I know that Marana is The Withering...? Dang it... everything's spinning...
Iotham, what was that green thing just now?
That was Ararakalari... It can protect people from the corrosion of Marana.
More and more things I don't understand...
This is... a kind of forest magic. It's also a kind of music... It's an Ara...
What is it?
Don't worry about that, Rana, you need to rest!
It's on the tip of my tongue, but...
I'm sorry, Rana, I'm sorry... I'll never run off like that again, I'll be good and stay home...
I know. You'll become smart, healthy, and you'll know right from wrong... It's just like knowing which mushrooms you can eat, and which you can't...
I know... I know... I'm sorry...
#Know that Marana is bad, and... the forest is good... Become a strong and good person, help people who need help... just like {NICKNAME} and Paimon...
And don't forget... the forest will remember...
Wah, this is bad, Paimon thinks Rana's condition is getting worse!
I'll go get help.
Eh? Oh... I'm fine, really... I just need to rest for a little while...
#{NICKNAME}, please... take Iotham back for me...
Okay. Let's go, Iotham. Don't move, Rana! We'll be right back!
Rana, wait for us.
Don't worry about that right now, rest up.
"Marana's Avatar"?
Uh-huh. It does bad things in the world for Marana... It's a big black thing...
"Marana"?
That's... The Withering.
Oh... Yeah, The Withering.

flow.stepDescription: Escort Iotham back to Vimara Village

dialogs.text: Don't worry about me... You guys go ahead.
#Iotham? Why are you... and {NICKNAME}...
It's urgent, so we'll make this quick...
You quickly explain what happened.
...I see. Iotham, you go rest up.
Okay. I'm sorry, Alphonso...
#It's fine, what matters is that you're okay... Wait here a moment, {NICKNAME}. I'll go with you as soon as I prepare some medicine.
There's no time. This is the location, head there as soon as you can.
Yeah, we have to hurry back to look after Rana...
Eh? Wait...
...Eh? Paimon's sure this was the place...
Rana! Can you hear Paimon?
Rana!
No answer... Darn it! What happened?
Hm...? These traces...
We'd better follow them... Maybe they're clues left for us by Rana.
What are these traces...
...Eh? Paimon's sure this was the place...
Rana! Can you hear Paimon?
Rana!
No answer... Darn it! What happened?
Hm...? These traces...
We'd better follow them... Maybe they're clues left for us by Rana.
What are these traces...
Hey! Rana! Can you hear Paimon?
What's going on here...? Could it be that Ara-thing Iotham and Rana were talking about? What was it called again?
"Ararakalari"?
Ah, yes, right, that was it! Paimon thinks they said it could resist the Marana corrosion or something...
Yes. Nara smart. Ararakalari can resist Marana.
Woah!
Woah!
Isn't this the thing we saw before...?
Phew... You scared Paimon! Paimon thought you were a talking vegetable...
Not vegetable, Arana. Arana is friend, Aranara.
"Aranara"...
Eh? Did you say Aranara? Now that Paimon's really looking at you, Paimon thinks we really have seen you before...
"Arana"...
Paimon thinks we heard this name when Iotham was telling that story before...
Yes. Nara Iotham is Arana's friend.
#Aranara are children of the forest, we live with trees. Not like you, Nara {NICKNAME}. You are the child of dandelion, always traveling.
#How do you know {NICKNAME}'s name?
How Arana knows, not important. But Arana wants to help Narana, this very important.
Narana... That's almost a tongue-twister.
You want to help Rana? What do you need us to do?
Thank you, you good Nara. She is Arana's very important friend. So, Arana will protect her.
#But that is not enough. To heal Narana, we need Bija. Nara {NICKNAME} must go to Vanarana and ask everyone to help get Bija.
Bija...
Narana got corroded by Marana, very serious. Bad bugs are biting tree roots. Trees will wither, fruits will rot.
Nara's life is like tree, bad bugs, like Marana. Only Bija can make Narana better.
Uh... So, we need to go somewhere called "Vanarana" and come up with a way to get this Bija, right? Then we can heal Rana?
Mm-hmm.
Then Rana's current condition...
No worry. Arana will be here and fight Marana corrosion. So, Rana will not get worse.
But with no Bija, Rana will not get better either.
Follow the forest path, keep going towards where water comes from, then you will reach Vanarana.
Then sing.
Sing?
(A melody is rising up in my mind...)
This is the Rhythm of the Great Dream. Sing it to enter Vanarana.
Enter our dreams, our world.
That'll attract Whopperflowers...
#Nara {NICKNAME}, very funny.
Got it. How do we get there?
What's that?
What do you need me to do?
"Arana"...
Paimon thinks we heard this name when Iotham was telling that story before...
Yes. Nara Iotham is Arana's friend.
"Aranara"...
Eh? Did you say Aranara? Now that Paimon's really looking at you, Paimon thinks we really have seen you before...
Vegetable...
What was that again?
Paimon thinks they said it could resist the Marana corrosion or something... It had a funny name.
It is Ararakalari. It can fight Marana. Ararakalari, NOT a funny name.
